transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: Alright, let's do a quick round. New Engineer, welcome to your first standup! Why don't you introduce yourself, then we'll go around.

transcript.speaker: New Engineer
transcript.text: Thanks! I just joined as a senior engineer. Excited to be here. Still getting oriented, but looking forward to diving in.

transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: Great to have you. Frontend Lead, you want to go next?

transcript.speaker: Frontend Lead
transcript.text: Sure. I'm still working on the Metrics Dashboard redesign. Hit a snag with the real-time charts—need to talk to the Backend Lead about the websocket connection.

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: Yeah, happy to sync on that. On my end, the Checkout Service refactor is going well. Got the new payment flow working locally. Should have a PR up by end of day.

transcript.speaker: Platform Lead
transcript.text: Quick heads up—the CI pipeline is running slow again. I've been investigating the CI Pipeline Slowdown issue. Looks like it's the test parallelization config. Should have a fix today.

transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: Good. The Platform Migration is still on track for the Q2 launch. Backend Lead, make sure the Checkout Service changes are compatible with the new architecture.

transcript.speaker: Backend Lead
transcript.text: Will do. I'll coordinate with the Platform Lead on the deployment strategy.

transcript.speaker: Technical Lead
transcript.text: Perfect. New Engineer, feel free to shadow the Backend Lead this week to get up to speed on the Checkout Service. Anything blocking anyone? No? Alright, let's get to it.
